tracks.title: Eggshell, Not Satin
tracks.mood: flirty, giddy and a little shameless
tracks.subject: inventing a new paint project every Saturday to flirt with the man at the hardware store mixing counter
tracks.caption: Retro disco-pop in the polished 2025 Hollywood-studio style. Live four-on-the-floor drums with an open hi-hat on every off-beat; an octave-jumping slap bass locked to the kick; a scratchy sixteenth-note funk rhythm guitar; a string section playing short rising stabs and long sweeps into each chorus; a clavinet comping between vocal lines. Polished and roomy, wide strings, bass and kick forward, a light plate reverb on the voice. Female voice, a breathy, wry light soprano, talking her way through the verses and opening into a bright stacked chorus. 116 BPM, A minor. Flirty, giddy and a little shameless. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build or drop, no synthwave arpeggios, no house piano.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass and string stabs]

[Verse 1]
Saturday at ten, I'm at the counter again
Last week the kitchen, now the hallway needs a lift
He shakes the can like he's playing maracas
Asks me what the room is for, I say I haven't decided

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't own a roller, Frank, I own a lot of samples

[Chorus]
Eggshell, not satin, I say it slow
Hold the chip to the window, let the colour show
Every wall in my flat is a shade of hello
Eggshell, not satin, mix me another, go

[Verse 2]
Now the bathroom's sage and the bedroom's something called Oat
My landlord left a voicemail, he says please stop painting
Frank writes my name on the lid with a marker
Spells it wrong on purpose so I'll come back and correct it

[Pre-Chorus]
I don't need a roller, Frank, I need a Saturday

[Chorus]
Eggshell, not satin, I say it slow
Hold the chip to the window, let the colour show
There's one wall left and you already know
Eggshell, not satin, come and help it go

[Outro - strings and clavinet fade]
Bring a brush on Sunday, Frank
I'll pick the colour, you pick the takeaway

tracks.title: Nobody Signed Up
tracks.mood: defiant, campy and laughing at the empty room
tracks.subject: the Wednesday karaoke host at a half-empty bowling alley singing the whole night herself when nobody signs up
tracks.caption: Camp theatrical synth-pop in the 2025 Midwest-princess cabaret style. A gated eighties drum machine with a big snapping snare and handclaps on two and four; a bouncing analog synth bass in eighth notes; glassy polysynth chords; a brassy lead synth answering the vocal like a saxophone. Bright and glossy, wide synths, the voice upfront with a short slap echo. Female voice, a belting mezzo with a theatrical country twang, tossing spoken asides in the verses and singing the chorus full-throat. 124 BPM, D major. Defiant, campy and laughing at the empty room. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rock guitar solo, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drum machine and synth bass]

[Verse 1]
Lane twelve's got a birthday, lane four's got a league
And there's not one name on the karaoke sheet
I tap the mic twice, I say is this thing on
The guy at the shoe rental gives me a thumbs up

[Pre-Chorus]
Fine, I'll go first, and second, and third

[Chorus]
Nobody signed up, so I'm singing them all
Rhinestones on, I'm hitting every single call
Pins go down like they're dancing for me
Nobody signed up, so the stage is free

[Verse 2]
Nine o'clock I'm doing the duet with myself
Switching sides of the stage for the high and the low
A strike on lane seven and I take it as a cheer
Somebody's nana orders nachos and stays

[Pre-Chorus]
Fine, she can have the encore, I'll do harmony

[Chorus]
Nobody signed up, so I'm singing them all
Nana's on the chorus and she's giving it her all
Pins go down like they're dancing for us
Nobody signed up, now they're signing up

[Outro - synth lead and handclaps]
Last call at eleven, put me down for one more
Spell it in glitter, put my name on the door

tracks.title: One Sink
tracks.subject: two people sharing one small bathroom sink every morning in a new flat
tracks.caption: Piano-led indie pop-rock in the 2025 alternative-radio crossover style. An upright piano with felt-softened hammers playing steady quarter-note chords; live drums starting with brushes and growing to a full kit with crashes in the final chorus; a warm bass guitar entering on the first chorus; a reverb-washed electric guitar holding long notes. Intimate verses with audible room noise, a wide and loud final chorus, the piano always in front. Male voice, a soft close baritone in the verses, cracking up into falsetto in the chorus and turning raw and loud at the end. 84 BPM, E-flat major. Tender, amused and quietly sure. No trap drums, no autotune, no orchestral strings, no gospel choir, no EDM build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano alone]

[Verse 1]
Seven-oh-five, the mirror's the size of a postcard
You lean left, I lean right, we take turns with the tap
You spit, I rinse, we've got it down to a rhythm
Toothpaste on your chin and you won't let me tell you

[Pre-Chorus]
Back in my old place I had two sinks and nobody

[Chorus]
One sink, two of us, elbows in the way
I'd rather bump into you than have the room all day
Fogged-up glass, you write your name in steam
One sink, and nowhere else I'd rather be

[Verse 2]
Your hair in the plughole, my razor on your shelf
You moved the soap again and I moved it back
We'll get a bigger place one day, you say it every Tuesday
I say sure, and we both know I'm lying

[Pre-Chorus]
Some mornings I pretend I'm late just to stand there longer

[Chorus - full band]
One sink, two of us, elbows in the way
I'd rather bump into you than have the room all day
Fogged-up glass, I write yes under your name
One sink, and I'm never moving again

[Outro - piano and brushes]
Seven-oh-six, you kiss me with a mouth full of mint

tracks.title: Half-Smoke, All The Way
tracks.subject: a lunchtime food-truck line on a DC sidewalk where the cook calls out orders in rhythm
tracks.caption: DC go-go in the classic live-band pocket. Congas and timbales driving the syncopated go-go swing beat with a cowbell on top; a tight kick and snare pocket; a busy funk bass; short brass horn section blasts on the hits; keyboard organ stabs. Live and sweaty, percussion forward, the crowd answers mixed loud, no gaps between sections. Male lead talker, a raspy baritone running call-and-response with a crowd that shouts back every line, chanting the chorus. 96 BPM, E minor. Rowdy, hungry and grinning. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no drum machine, no EDM drop, no rap verse over a beat track.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - congas, cowbell and timbales]

[Verse 1]
Twelve-oh-two on Fourteenth Street, the line's around the corner
Big Tony in the window got the tongs up like a drumstick
He don't write nothing down, he just calls it on the beat
Half-smoke, chili, onions, now who's next, who's next

[Pre-Chorus]
If you're hungry say yeah
Yeah
If you're late for work say yeah
Yeah

[Chorus]
Half-smoke, all the way
Big Tony, what you say
Mustard on the left side, napkin in the bag
Half-smoke, all the way

[Verse 2]
Lady from the bank wants it no onion, Tony shakes his head
Man in the suit tryna pay with his phone, Tony points at the sign
Cash only since 1998, he hollers it in time
Whole line stomping on the sidewalk like a show

[Chorus - crowd louder]
Half-smoke, all the way
Big Tony, what you say
Cash in the bucket and the cheese on top
Half-smoke, and the beat don't stop

[Outro - horns and percussion]
Tony says come back tomorrow
Same time, same song

tracks.title: Tombola In The Rain
tracks.mood: cheeky, soaked and refusing to go home
tracks.subject: a village fete that gets rained off while everyone keeps going under the tea tent
tracks.caption: Two-tone ska revival in the 2025 UK grassroots style. A choppy off-beat electric guitar skank; a bouncing walking bass; tight snare-heavy drums with rimshots; a Farfisa organ bubbling on the off-beats; trombone and tenor sax playing unison riffs between lines. Raw and punchy, dry room sound, horns and organ wide, the voice upfront. Male voice, a cheeky half-shouted tenor with a flat Midlands accent, group backing shouts on the chorus. 150 BPM, G major. Cheeky, soaked and refusing to go home. No reggaeton, no pop-punk power chords, no autotune, no trap drums, no synthesizers.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - guitar skank and horns]

[Verse 1]
Two o'clock in Little Hadley and the sky came down
The coconut shy floated off across the green
Mrs Patel's Victoria sponge is under a bin bag
The vicar's on the tombola with his trousers rolled

[Pre-Chorus]
Nobody's going, nobody's going home

[Chorus]
Tombola in the rain, ticket number nine
Won a bottle of shampoo and a tin of pineapple rings
Forty of us squashed in the tea tent
Tombola in the rain and we're having a time

[Verse 2]
Brass band's playing the same three songs louder every round
Dog show judge has given every dog a rosette
Somebody's uncle dancing with the raffle table
Tea's gone cold and the tent's starting to lean

[Pre-Chorus]
Nobody's going, the pole's going instead

[Chorus]
Tombola in the rain, ticket number ten
Won the shampoo back and I gave it away again
Tent comes down and we're still stood there
Tombola in the rain, same time next year

[Outro - horns and organ]
Little Hadley, drying out by Tuesday

tracks.title: Sound Horeg Pak RT
tracks.mood: rowdy, sleepless and laughing about it
tracks.subject: a neighbourhood head's son testing a rented stack of sound-system speakers at two in the morning before a wedding, and the windows rattle until the whole alley comes out and dances
tracks.caption: DJ jedag-jedug remix in the Indonesian TikTok breakbeat style. A pumping detuned supersaw lead playing a short four-note riff; a booming 808 sub bass with a hard sidechain pump; a breakbeat drum loop with fast snare rolls into every chorus; live kendang koplo fills slapping between phrases; a thin whistling synth lead like a suling. Loud and brickwalled, huge sub, tinny top end like a rented street sound system. Male voice, a loud grinning tenor, half-shouting the verses and singing the chorus, a crowd shouting 'goyang' on the downbeats. 135 BPM, A minor. Rowdy, sleepless and laughing about it. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no slow ballad intro, no dubstep wobble, no English rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - supersaw riff and kendang fills]

[Verse 1]
Jam dua pagi, Ndaru anaknya Pak RT
Nyewa sound dua belas buat nikahan kakaknya besok
Cek satu dua, kaca jendela ikut gemeter
Kucing tetangga lompat ke genteng nggak balik lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
Bu Har buka pintu bawa sapu
Eh, kakinya malah ikut maju

[Chorus]
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, satu gang nggak tidur
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, goyang dulu, besok libur
Pak RT keluar pakai sarung mau marah
Tiga detik kemudian dia paling depan, goyang sarung

[Verse 2]
Jam tiga satpam kompleks ikut dateng
Senternya diputer-puter kayak lampu disko
Bayi di rumah ujung malah ketawa
Cuma mbah Darmo yang tidur, kupingnya udah kurang denger

[Pre-Chorus]
Ada yang lapor ke grup WA
Yang bales cuma stiker joget semua

[Chorus]
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, satu gang nggak tidur
Jedag jedug, jedag jedug, goyang dulu, besok libur
Subuh dateng, Ndaru matiin kabelnya
Pak RT teriak, satu lagu lagi, nanggung

[Outro - kendang koplo and sub bass fade]
Besok nikahannya, kita semua ngantuk
Tapi goyangnya udah hafal duluan

tracks.title: Gitar Dijual
tracks.subject: a student selling his guitar to pay the boarding-house rent, and the buyer, a high-school kid, asks him to play one last song before taking it
tracks.caption: Indonesian folk-pop band in the reflective 2025 streaming style. A fingerpicked nylon-string guitar with soft thumb bass notes; a strummed ukulele on the off-beats; an acoustic bass walking gently under the chorus; a brushed cajon keeping a light shuffle; a breathy harmonica answering the vocal between lines. Warm and dry, bedroom-close, wood and strings forward. Male voice, a soft close baritone singing like he is telling a friend, a female harmony joining on the last chorus. 84 BPM, D major. Quiet, rueful, a little proud. No electric guitar solo, no drum kit, no autotune, no orchestral strings, no EDM build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked nylon guitar]

[Verse 1]
Kupasang di marketplace, tujuh ratus nego
Foto di kasur kos, senarnya baru kuganti
Yang dateng anak SMA, naik motor sama bapaknya
Uangnya dihitung pelan, lecek semua, ribuan

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia bilang, Mas, sekali lagi aja
Mainin lagu yang Mas paling bisa

[Chorus]
Jadi kumainkan pelan di teras kos
Lagu yang dulu kupakai nembak Rina, gagal
Bapaknya ngangguk, anaknya diem
Gitarku pamit, bayar sewa bulan ini

[Verse 2]
Ada stiker band di belakang badannya
Bekas tutup botol nempel di dekat lubang
Kubilang jangan dicopot, itu dari Jogja
Dia ketawa, iya Mas, nanti kutambahin

[Pre-Chorus]
Ibu kos lewat bawa kunci
Kali ini nggak nanya kapan bayar lagi

[Chorus]
Jadi kumainkan pelan di teras kos
Lagu yang dulu kupakai nembak Rina, gagal
Motornya pergi, gitarnya di punggung
Kayaknya di tangan dia lagunya bakal jadi

[Outro - ukulele alone]
Bulan depan aku nyanyi pakai meja
Ketukannya nggak fals, kok

tracks.title: Transit Manggarai
tracks.genre: Indonesian art rock with tribal percussion
tracks.subject: changing trains at Manggarai station at seven in the morning, pushed up the stairs by the crowd while holding a box of birthday cake for a colleague
tracks.caption: Indonesian art rock with tribal percussion, in the Barasuara arena style. Two interlocking electric guitars, one clean and arpeggiated, one overdriven and chugging; a stack of floor toms and tribal toms pounding in unison patterns; a driving eighth-note electric bass; a low synth drone holding the root. Wide and loud, drums huge and roomy, guitars split left and right, raw live-band feel. Male and female lead voices trading lines in an urgent rhythmic mid-range, a shouted gang vocal on the chorus. 150 BPM, E minor. Breathless, tense, stubbornly funny. No pop-punk power chords, no metal growls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no ballad breakdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pounding toms and guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
Jam tujuh lewat lima, pintu kereta terbuka
Aku keluar bukan jalan, aku keluar didorong
Kotak kue di tangan kanan, tulisan Selamat Ultah Bu Wati
Tangga naik ke peron enam, semua orang lari

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan miring, jangan miring
Krimnya udah nempel di plastik

[Chorus]
Manggarai, Manggarai, tahan napas, tahan kotak
Ribuan bahu, satu arah, satu tangga yang sesak
Manggarai, Manggarai, kakiku nggak napak lantai
Pintu kereta ke Bekasi nutup, aku pas di dalam

[Verse 2]
Bapak di depan bawa galon, ibu di belakang bawa tikar
Petugas teriak, Ikuti jalur, kuning di kanan
Ada anak kecil tidur di bahu ayahnya
Dia satu-satunya yang santai di sini

[Pre-Chorus]
Jangan miring, jangan miring
Lilinnya patah, nggak apa-apa

[Chorus]
Manggarai, Manggarai, tahan napas, tahan kotak
Ribuan bahu, satu arah, satu tangga yang sesak
Manggarai, Manggarai, kotaknya penyok di pojok
Bu Wati nanti ketawa, kuenya tetep enak

[Outro - toms alone, then one guitar chord]
Jam delapan kurang lima, kotaknya kubuka
Tulisannya tinggal Selamat Bu

tracks.title: Lagu Buat Eyang
tracks.subject: a man learning an old keroncong song on a borrowed ukulele for six weeks to sing at his girlfriend's grandmother's eightieth birthday, so the family will take him seriously
tracks.caption: Indonesian 90s jazz-pop vocal group in the Kahitna revival style. A Fender Rhodes playing lush ninth and eleventh chords; a smooth fretless electric bass sliding between roots; a brushed jazz drum kit with soft rimshots and a light swing; muted trumpet fills between vocal phrases; stacked four-part male close-harmony backing vocals. Polished 1990s studio sheen, warm and round, harmonies spread wide, gentle plate reverb. Male voice, a smooth light tenor with relaxed jazzy phrasing, the group answering in close harmony. 96 BPM, E-flat major. Warm, smitten, gently teasing. No trap drums, no autotune, no rock guitar, no EDM synths, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and muted trumpet]

[Verse 1]
Enam minggu lalu kamu bilang
Eyang ulang tahun yang kedelapan puluh
Beliau suka lagu keroncong lama
Aku pinjam ukulele tetangga kos

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiap malam aku latihan
Sampai jari merah dan tetangga protes

[Chorus]
Lagu buat Eyang, aku nyanyi pelan
Biar kunci salah, yang penting sungguhan
Lagu buat Eyang, buat kamu juga
Di depan keluargamu aku nggak lari

[Verse 2]
Malam itu rumah penuh sepupu
Om-om duduk sambil melirik tajam
Suaraku gemetar di baris pertama
Eyang pelan-pelan ikut bersenandung

[Pre-Chorus]
Di bait kedua satu ruangan nyanyi
Kamu senyum sambil tutup muka

[Chorus]
Lagu buat Eyang, aku nyanyi pelan
Eyang tepuk tanganku, bilang lumayan
Lagu buat Eyang, buat kamu juga
Minggu depan Om ajak aku mancing

[Outro - Rhodes and close harmony]
Ukulele tetangga, belum kubalikin

tracks.title: Kabut Sikunir
tracks.subject: riding a motorbike up to Sikunir hill on the Dieng plateau at four in the morning with a friend to see the sunrise, and seeing nothing but white fog
tracks.caption: Indonesian shoegaze in the Bandung and Medan scene style. Walls of fuzzed electric guitars with reverse reverb and slow tremolo-bar bends; a steady mid-tempo drum kit with washed, smeared cymbals; a melodic electric bass carrying the main tune under the noise; a soft organ drone holding the chord. Dense and blurred, loud but soft-edged, long reverb tails, the vocals buried in the guitars. Female voice, a breathy calm soprano mixed low, a male voice doubling an octave below. 112 BPM, F-sharp major. Hazy, cold, quietly delighted. No clean pop vocal up front, no trap beat, no autotune, no metal riffing, no acoustic guitar.

Kamu bilang, udah, ini juga pemandangan

[Pre-Chorus]
Foto kita isinya cuma kabut
Dua muka nyengir di pojokan

[Chorus]

Kabutnya ikut pulang di rambutmu

tracks.title: 袋詰めエリア
tracks.mood: flustered, comic, getting angrier and funnier
tracks.subject: losing a ten-minute argument with a supermarket self-checkout that keeps saying an item is in the bagging area
tracks.caption: Jersey club J-rap in the 2024 anime-opening crossover style. A Jersey club kick pattern in bouncing triplet bursts, a bed-squeak sample on the off-beats, rapid hand-clap rolls, a plucky square-wave synth riff repeating a four-note figure, a deep sub bass hitting with the kick, and a short checkout-scanner beep used as a percussion hit. Dry and punchy mix, kick and claps forward, synth riff narrow and bright, no reverb tails. Two male rappers trading lines in a fast tongue-twister flow, a shouted call-and-response hook. 140 BPM, F minor. Flustered and comic, getting angrier and funnier. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM build or drop, no rock guitar, no sung ballad bridge.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - checkout beep, claps and sub bass]

[Verse 1]
キャベツ一個とビール二本 ピッとやってハイ終わり
のはずが画面が真っ赤 係員をお呼びしますだと
置いてないって 何も置いてない 袋はまだ空っぽだ
財布くわえて両手を上げる 見てくれ俺は無実だ

[Pre-Chorus]
もう一回ピッ もう一回ピッ
後ろのおばちゃん ため息ひとつ

[Chorus]
袋詰めエリア 袋詰めエリア
何も置いてないのに 袋詰めエリア
キャベツは手の中 ビールはカゴの中
機械と俺の 十分間

[Verse 2]
バイトの子が来て カードかざしてピッ
一秒で直って 俺の顔だけ赤い
ありがとうって言う前に また鳴る あのアナウンス
レシートの重さで 反応してたらしい

[Pre-Chorus]
もう一回ピッ もう一回ピッ
おばちゃん ついに笑い出す

[Chorus]
袋詰めエリア 袋詰めエリア
レシート一枚で 袋詰めエリア
明日から有人レジ 三人並んでても
機械と俺は 絶交だ

[Outro - claps fade, one last beep]
ありがとうございました またお越しください
行かねえよ たぶん明日も来るけど

tracks.title: 改札前ダンス
tracks.subject: a girl who practises a dance challenge in the dark glass by the station ticket gates every morning, until the salaryman who waits there starts copying the moves
tracks.caption: Girl-group hip-hop J-pop in the 2025 audition-group style. Boom-clap hip-hop drums with a heavy round kick, a finger-snapped synth bass line walking under the verses, brassy stab chords on the downbeats, muted funk guitar playing short sixteenth-note scratches, and a handclap-only breakdown. Glossy and wide, drums and bass heavy, rap lines dry and close, the group voices stacked thick in the hook. Female group, a low alto rapper carrying the verses with a cool swagger, a bright soprano singing the hook, unison chants between. 96 BPM, A minor. Cocky and playful, laughing it off. No K-pop EDM drop, no trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no ballad piano, no rock guitar solo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - brass stabs and snaps]

[Verse 1]
朝七時半 改札の前

横に立ってる スーツのおじさん

改札前ダンス 間違えても

[Verse 2]
月曜 おじさん 目そらしてた

金曜 隣で 同じターン
ネクタイ ひらっと 回ってた

[Pre-Chorus]
目が合って 二人で吹き出す
駅員さんまで 手を叩く

[Chorus]
改札前ダンス 二人になった
電車来るまで あと一分
改札前ダンス おじさん上手い
悔しいけど 明日も来る

[Outro - handclaps only]
ピッ 改札 またあした

tracks.title: 借りたままのベース
tracks.subject: taking the train across town to return a bass guitar to a bandmate who quit the band two years ago
tracks.caption: Japanese midwest emo with math-rock edges, in the vein of the 2025 Tokyo emo underground. A twinkly clean Telecaster in an open tuning playing tapped arpeggios, a second guitar with a light chorus pedal strumming open chords, a melodic picked bass moving against the guitars, busy live drums with ride-bell accents and odd fills, and a plain trumpet line entering in the last chorus. Roomy live-band sound, guitars panned wide, unpolished, drums natural with room mics. Male tenor, earnest and slightly strained, half-speaking the verses and pushing into the chorus, a shouted gang vocal at the end. 132 BPM, D major. Wistful, awkward and quietly fond. No pop-punk power chords, no screamo, no autotune, no synth pads, no polished radio-rock sheen.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tapped guitar arpeggio, drums enter on bar four]

[Verse 1]
ソフトケースの肩紐が 二年ぶりに食い込む
中央線 ドアの横 ネックが吊り革に当たる
お前が抜けたあの夏から 押し入れの奥に立ってた
ステッカーは剥がさないでおいた

[Pre-Chorus]
三鷹で降りて 坂を上がる
既読のまま 住所だけ来た

[Chorus]
返しに来ただけだよ
弦は張り替えといたから
チューニングは知らない
もう俺のじゃないから

[Verse 2]
ドアを開けたお前は 髭なんか生やしてて
奥で赤ん坊が泣いてる 言ってくれよ そういうの
ケースを渡して 玄関で 十分も立ち話
あのライブの客 七人だったよな

[Pre-Chorus]
上がってけよって言われて
靴を脱ぐのに 手間取った

[Chorus]
返しに来ただけだよ
弦は張り替えといたから
たまには弾いてやれよ
その子が寝たあとで

[Outro - trumpet and gang vocals]
帰りの電車 肩が軽すぎる
来週 スタジオ 空いてるけど

tracks.title: 片耳ずつ
tracks.genre: Japanese liquid drum and bass pop
tracks.subject: an overnight highway bus from Osaka to Tokyo, sharing one pair of earbuds with your boyfriend while he falls asleep on your shoulder
tracks.caption: Japanese liquid drum and bass pop. A rolling liquid breakbeat with soft ghost snares and a light shuffling ride, warm Rhodes electric piano holding major-seventh chords, a deep round sub bass moving in half time, airy acoustic guitar harmonics answering the vocal, and a quiet rain-on-glass field recording at the start. Smooth and warm, drums crisp but never harsh, Rhodes and voice centred, gentle stereo width. Female mezzo, soft and close, breathy but in tune, singing in long relaxed phrases over the fast drums. 172 BPM, E-flat major. Tender, sleepy and content. No neurofunk or reese bass, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - rain on glass, Rhodes, breakbeat fades in]

[Verse 1]
二十三時 梅田のバス乗り場
カーテン閉めた 四列シート
イヤホンの右を あなたに渡して
左を私が つけた

[Pre-Chorus]
同じ曲が 半分ずつ
聞こえてる

[Chorus]
片耳ずつで ちょうどいい
あなたの寝息が 左から
名古屋を過ぎても 起こさない
肩が少し しびれてても

[Verse 2]
サービスエリアの 灯りが過ぎる
毛布の下で 手を探す
寝ぼけた声で 今どこって
まだ静岡 寝てていいよ

[Pre-Chorus]
あなたの耳に 何が鳴ってるか
わかってる

[Chorus]
片耳ずつで ちょうどいい
あなたの寝息が 左から
新宿に着いても 降りるまで
このままで いさせてね

[Outro - Rhodes and rain]
朝の六時 バスタ新宿
イヤホン 返してくれない

tracks.title: 曲がったキュウリ
tracks.subject: an old man whose community-garden cucumbers all grew curled, handing them out door to door in his apartment block anyway
tracks.caption: Japanese bluegrass in the Kansai festival-band tradition. A five-string banjo playing fast Scruggs-style rolls, a flatpicked steel-string acoustic guitar with G-runs at the ends of lines, short fiddle breaks between verses, a mandolin chopping on the backbeat, and an upright bass walking a steady two-beat. Acoustic and live, a one-room string band with no drums, each instrument stepping up for a short break. Male lead, a high nasal tenor with a wry spoken aside, three-part close bluegrass harmony on the chorus. 128 BPM, G major. Cheerful, proud and mock-boastful. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no pedal steel, no country-pop gloss, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - banjo roll, fiddle kick-off]

[Verse 1]
団地の裏の 市民農園 区画は三番 わしの畑
春に植えたキュウリの苗が 七月に全部 くるっと曲がった
肥料が悪いか 水が多いか 隣の畑は まっすぐなのに
まあ味だけは 変わらんやろ

[Pre-Chorus]
ビニール袋に 十本ずつ
エレベーターで 上から配る

[Chorus]
曲がったキュウリ 持っていきな
まっすぐなのは スーパーにある
味噌つけて かじってみな
わしのは ちゃんと 曲がっとる

[Verse 2]
五階の奥さん 笑って受け取る 四階の坊主は 指さして笑う
二階のじいさん 割れたトマトを 交換やって 差し出してくる
お互い様や 形やないで 夕方 浅漬けが 返ってきた

[Pre-Chorus]
まだ十二本 冷蔵庫にある
明日は管理人室 行こうかね

[Chorus]
曲がったキュウリ 持っていきな
冷やして塩振りゃ 文句ないやろ
来年もまた 同じ畑
たぶん今年より 曲がっとる

[Outro - fiddle and banjo tag]
おい ブーメランじゃないぞ
投げても戻らんぞ

tracks.title: 바나나우유 스캔
tracks.mood: frustrated, wry, laughing at himself by the last chorus
tracks.subject: the morning after being dumped by text, still opening the six a.m. convenience-store shift and scanning her favourite banana milk for every customer who buys one
tracks.caption: Korean emo pop-rock in the 2020s solo-singer band style. Overdriven electric guitars chugging palm-muted eighth notes that open into ringing power chords on the chorus; a clean arpeggiated electric guitar line in the verses; live rock drums with a driving snare and crash-heavy choruses; a picked electric bass locked to the kick; a few upright-piano chords in the intro. Dry and close in the verses, wide double-tracked guitars in the chorus, lead vocal forward. Male tenor, breathy and half-spoken in the verses, a strained high belt in the chorus. 148 BPM, E major. Frustrated and wry, laughing at himself by the end. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no synth pads, no metal growls, no ballad string section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano, then palm-muted guitar]

[Verse 1]
새벽 네 시 문자 한 통
우리 그만하자 마침표까지
여섯 시엔 가게 문 열어야 해서
울 시간도 없이 조끼를 입었어

[Pre-Chorus]
첫 손님이 계산대에 올려놓은 건
하필이면 바나나우유

[Chorus]
삑 바나나우유
네가 맨날 빨대 꽂아 달라던 거
삑 바나나우유
오늘따라 왜 다들 이것만 사

[Verse 2]
택배 기사님 하나 학생 둘
출근하는 누나까지 또 하나
냉장고 칸이 텅 비어 가는데
내 속은 왜 이렇게 꽉 차 있지

[Pre-Chorus]
마지막 하나 남은 걸 보다가
그냥 내 돈으로 찍었어

[Chorus]
삑 바나나우유
빨대는 내가 꽂고 내가 마셔
삑 바나나우유
생각보다 너무 달아 웃음이 나

[Outro - clean guitar alone]
다음 근무엔 딸기우유 마셔야지

tracks.caption: K-pop electropop anthem in the 2025 film-soundtrack girl-group style. A bright saw-wave lead synth riff, a four-on-the-floor kick with layered handclaps, a sidechained pulsing synth bass, staccato piano stabs pushing the pre-chorus, stacked girl-group harmonies. Glossy and wide, punchy low end, vocals stacked and upfront. Female group vocals, a bright head-voice lead in the verses, a powerful sustained high belt on the final chorus, unison group shouts on the chorus. 124 BPM, C# minor. Breathless, stubborn and triumphant. No trap hi-hat rolls, no rap verse, no autotune, no dubstep drop, no acoustic guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - saw-lead synth riff and handclaps]

[Verse 1]
마흔둘, 배번 삼천칠백팔
출발선 맨 뒤에 서 있었어
과장님은 내가 걷다 올 거래
신발 끈만 세 번을 묶었어

[Pre-Chorus]
십오 킬로, 다리가 내 말을 안 들어
물 한 컵 받고 그냥 계속 가

[Chorus]
이십일 점 공구칠오
남은 건 딱 이 킬로
시계는 이제 그만하래도
난 아직 안 끝났어

[Verse 2]
회수차가 뒤에서 천천히 따라와
경찰 아저씨가 길을 열어 줘
모르는 아줌마가 내 이름을 불러
배번에 적힌 내 이름

[Pre-Chorus]
마지막 코너, 풍선 아치가 보여
이제 남은 건 숨 한 번

[Chorus]
이십일 점 공구칠오
마감 일 분 전 골인
과장님한테 사진 보낼 거야
나 끝까지 뛰어 왔어

[Outro - synth riff fading, crowd claps]
월요일엔 메달 걸고 출근해

tracks.caption: Boyhood pop in the 2025 Korean boy-group style with retro electric guitar. tracks.title: 흰색 두 번
tracks.subject: a couple painting the walls of their first rented flat white late at night, rollers in hand, and her leaving one handprint low behind the wardrobe on purpose
tracks.caption: Korean shoegaze in the 2020s Seoul indie style. Layered fuzz electric guitars drenched in reverb with slow tremolo-arm bends; slow steady drums with a washy ride cymbal; a round melodic electric bass carrying the tune under the noise; a faint organ drone. Dense wall of reverb, warm saturated mids, vocals mixed low and close inside the guitars. Female and male duet, soft breathy voices, unhurried. 92 BPM, D major. Hazy, tender and quietly devoted. No trap drums, no autotune, no pop vocal belting, no EDM build, no clean acoustic ballad arrangement.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar swell and organ drone]

[Verse 1]
밤 열한 시 우리 첫 전셋집
신문지 깔고 창문 다 열고
롤러 하나씩 들고 서서
누런 벽을 흰색으로 덮어

[Pre-Chorus]
너는 천장 쪽 나는 바닥 쪽
페인트 냄새에 둘 다 웃음이 나

[Chorus]
흰색 두 번 칠하면 돼
누렇던 벽 위에
흰색 두 번 칠하는 동안
여기가 우리 집이 돼 가

[Verse 2]
네 머리끝에 하얀 점 하나
내 볼에도 하나 묻었대
새벽 두 시 마지막 벽 앞에서
너는 손바닥을 꾹 찍었어

[Pre-Chorus]
옷장 뒤 낮은 곳이니까
아무도 모를 거라며

[Chorus]
흰색 두 번 칠하고 나면
손자국만 남겨 두자
흰색 두 번 칠한 이 방에
오래오래 같이 살자

[Outro - guitars dissolving into the organ]
창밖이 밝아 오고 벽이 말라 가

tracks.title: 로봇청소기랑 금요일
tracks.subject: dancing alone at home on a Friday night with the robot vacuum until it gets stuck under the sofa
tracks.caption: UK garage 2-step idol pop in the Korean girl-group lineage. Shuffling 2-step garage drums with skippy syncopated kicks and crisp rimshots, a warm wobbling sub bass, swung organ-chord stabs, a plucky synth arpeggio over the chorus. Clean and bouncy, deep sub, spacious mids, a close dry lead vocal. Female solo voice, a light conversational alto, playful talk-sung verses, an airy sung chorus. 132 BPM, F minor. Silly, loose and Friday-night free. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no big EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - 2-step drums and organ stabs]

[Verse 1]
금요일 밤 아홉 시, 약속은 다 취소
양말 신고 거실 한가운데 서
충전기에서 내려온 우리 집 동글이
웅 하고 내 발 앞에 와

[Pre-Chorus]
왼쪽으로 가면 나도 왼쪽
벽에 부딪히면 나도 멈춰

[Chorus]
로봇청소기랑 금요일
너는 바닥 나는 리듬
과자 부스러기 흘려 줄게
한 바퀴만 더 돌자

[Verse 2]
베란다 문턱 앞에서 넌 고민해
나는 리모컨으로 박자를 세
엄마 전화는 이따 받을래
지금은 둘이 바빠

[Pre-Chorus]
소파 밑으로 쏙 들어가더니
삐삐, 거기서 안 나와

[Chorus]
로봇청소기랑 금요일
너는 소파 밑 나는 혼자
손전등 켜고 엎드려서
이름 불러 줄게, 동글아

[Outro - drums drop to rimshots]
삐삐, 나 여기 있어
다음 주 금요일도 비워 둘게

tracks.title: Voice Note Mak Long
tracks.mood: cheeky, exasperated and laughing at the family
tracks.subject: a family WhatsApp group where an aunt sends a four-minute voice note every morning before the subuh alarm
tracks.caption: Hipdut, the 2025 Malaysian hip-hop and dangdut fusion. A kendang dangdut hand drum playing the tak-dut groove with crisp slaps; a bamboo suling flute answering each line with short bent phrases; a boom-bap drum machine with a dry snare and a soft kick; a round electric bass walking under the kendang; a nylon dangdut guitar playing quick tremolo fills. Dry and punchy mix, kendang and lead voice forward, a short slap delay on the suling. Male voice, mid register, rapping the verses in a relaxed conversational flow and singing the chorus with a light dangdut cengkok bend. 98 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, exasperated, laughing at the family. No trap 808 slides, no autotune, no EDM drop, no koplo double-time, no rock guitar, no gospel choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kendang groove and suling]

[Verse 1]
Pukul lima pagi telefon aku bergetar
Group Keluarga Besar, Mak Long dah mula bersuara
Empat minit suara, ayam berkokok kat belakang
Pasal harga gula, pasal anak jiran yang hilang

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tekan play, separuh mata terbuka
Dia sebut nama aku, adoi, apa pula?

[Chorus]
Voice note Mak Long, belum subuh dah sampai
Satu kampung dengar, aku pun tak boleh lari
Laju dua kali pun masih panjang lagi
Voice note Mak Long, selamat pagi

[Verse 2]
Petang tu dia tanya kenapa aku tak balas
Blue tick dua, Mak Long, saya bukan tak ikhlas
Pak Ngah hantar sticker kucing menangis tiga kali
Sepupu kat Johor tukar nama group lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
Malam aku rakam satu, panjang lima minit
Mak Long balas satu emoji, ibu jari je

[Chorus]
Voice note Mak Long, belum subuh dah sampai
Satu kampung dengar, aku pun tak boleh lari
Esok aku bangun dulu, aku yang mula hari
Voice note anak saudara, selamat pagi

[Outro - suling and kendang alone]
Mak Long, saya dah bangun
Ayam pun belum bangun

tracks.title: Payung Satu
tracks.subject: a newly married couple sharing one small umbrella from the LRT station to their flat, the husband letting his own shoulder get soaked
tracks.caption: Inang-dangdut, the modern traditional Malay inang style of Siti Nurhaliza's 2025 traditional album. A Malay violin playing ornamented lines between phrases; an accordion holding the harmony with gentle bellows swells; rebana frame drum and kendang locked in the lilting inang rhythm with a soft dangdut lift; a gambus plucking short answering figures; a soft upright bass. Warm and roomy, violin and voice forward, light hall reverb. Female voice, clear sweet soprano with traditional Malay grace notes on the long vowels; a soft male voice joining in harmony on the last chorus. 112 BPM, D minor. Tender, shy and warm. No pop ballad piano, no trap beat, no autotune, no electric guitar solo, no synth pads.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - violin and accordion over rebana]

[Verse 1]
Hujan turun masa kita keluar stesen
Payung kecil, bunga biru, beli di Jalan Masjid India
Abang pegang hulu, condong ke arah saya
Bahu kiri abang dah basah kuyup sampai siku

[Pre-Chorus]
Saya kata rapat sikit, abang buat tak dengar
Senyum macam tak ada apa-apa

[Chorus]
Payung satu, kita berdua
Tujuh minit ke pintu rumah kita
Abang basah, saya kering
Itu cara abang cakap sayang

[Verse 2]
Sampai lobi, abang perah lengan baju
Pak guard ketawa, dah tiga hari begitu
Esok saya beli payung yang lebih besar
Abang kata tak payah, yang ini cukup

[Pre-Chorus]
Rupanya bukan pasal hujan
Abang cuma nak jalan dekat

[Chorus - male voice joins]
Payung satu, kita berdua
Tujuh minit ke pintu rumah kita
Esok saya pegang hulu
Biar bahu saya pula yang basah

[Outro - violin alone]
Hujan dah berhenti
Kita jalan lambat lagi

tracks.title: Zumba Wajib
tracks.subject: HR's compulsory Friday-evening Zumba session in the office meeting room, and the stiff finance manager who turns out to be the best dancer on the floor
tracks.caption: Electro-disco live party band in the current Malaysian live-band style. Live four-on-the-floor drums with open hi-hats on the off-beat; an octave-jumping slap bass doubled by a fat analog synth bass; a tenor saxophone blowing short riffs between lines; a choppy funk rhythm guitar on the upbeats; string-machine stabs on the chorus. Glossy and loud, kick and bass wide, saxophone and lead voice forward, a short plate reverb. Male voice, bright playful tenor, talk-singing the verses and belting the chorus; the band shouting the dance counts in unison. 122 BPM, F minor. Giddy, sweaty and triumphant. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no rock guitar solo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drums and slap bass, saxophone riff]

[Verse 1]
Jumaat pukul lima, e-mel dari HR
Semua staf wajib turun bilik mesyuarat
Meja ditolak tepi, kerusi disusun
Cikgu Zumba datang dengan speaker besar

[Pre-Chorus]
Encik Rahman finance, tali leher kemas
Berdiri belakang sekali, muka masam

[Chorus]
Zumba wajib, kiri kanan pusing
Peluh dah basah baju kerja
Zumba wajib, satu dua tiga
Siapa sangka bos kita boleh goyang

[Verse 2]
Lagu kedua, Encik Rahman buka kot
Lagu ketiga, dia ke depan sekali
Pinggul dia laju, tangan dia lawa
Cikgu Zumba pun berhenti tengok

[Pre-Chorus]
Rupanya dulu dia juara tari
Masa belajar kat Shah Alam

[Chorus]
Zumba wajib, ikut Encik Rahman
Budak IT pun tak nak balik
Zumba wajib, satu dua tiga
Minggu depan kita minta dua kali

[Outro - saxophone and drums]
Claim kewangan lambat pun tak apa

tracks.title: Makan Mana?
tracks.subject: a couple of five years stuck in a parked Myvi at eight at night unable to decide where to eat, ending at the same nasi lemak stall as always
tracks.caption: Malay conversational duet pop in the mid-tempo 2025 duet style. A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carrying the groove; an upright piano comping short chords; a brushed drum kit with a soft kick; a warm electric bass; a light string quartet entering only on the last chorus. Intimate and dry, the two voices panned slightly apart, the guitar forward. Male and female duet, both mid register, trading lines like a real conversation and singing the chorus together in close harmony. 96 BPM, E major. Playful, bickering and fond. No slow power-ballad build, no belting climax, no trap beat, no autotune, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1 - Duet, trading lines]
Sayang, nak makan mana malam ni?
Ikut awak, saya tak kisah
Kedai Thai kat Seksyen Tujuh?
Pedas sangat, perut saya tak larat

tracks.title: Meja Bulat Cikgu Pencen
tracks.subject: three retired school teachers, Malay, Chinese and Indian, arguing over the newspaper crossword at the same round kopitiam table every morning
tracks.caption: Malaysian multi-ethnic folk fusion in the style of the 2025 National Day theme that weaves folk instruments from several communities. A gambus lute plucking quick ornamented lines; an erhu answering with sliding phrases; a tabla playing a light rolling groove under a rebana ubi frame drum on the downbeats; a strummed nylon-string guitar holding the chords; a unison male group vocal on the chorus. Organic and bright, a live room sound, gambus and erhu trading phrases left and right. Male voice, warm storytelling baritone, conversational verses, three voices together on the chorus. 108 BPM, G major. Warm, wry and lively. No patriotic anthem build, no orchestral swell, no trap beat, no autotune, no synth pads, no sape.

tracks.title: 浸跤 Tsìm Kha
tracks.subject: a husband who has a basin of hot ginger water ready every night when his wife gets home from twelve hours standing at a department-store cosmetics counter
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien neo-soul in the loose, behind-the-beat style. Rhodes electric piano playing extended seventh and ninth chords with a slow tremolo; dusty drums with a lazy swung hi-hat and a soft rimshot; a round finger-style electric bass sliding between chord tones; muted nylon-string guitar fills between the vocal lines. Intimate late-night mix, warm tape saturation, small room reverb, everything close. A warm male tenor sung close to the mic, conversational in the verses, rising to a soft falsetto on the hook. 84 BPM, Eb major. Tender, patient and quietly amused. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build, no rap verse, no big gospel choir.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
十點半 鐵門拉落來
你穿高踏鞋 轉來到厝
規工徛佇 化妝品櫃台
笑甲喙顊 攏硬去矣

[Pre-Chorus]
我早就煮好 一鼎薑母水
倒落面桶 燒甲咧衝煙

[Chorus]
來 跤囥落來 慢慢仔浸
燒水淹過 你的跤目
十二點鐘 徛甲無歇
這馬換我 跍佇你面前

[Verse]
你講今仔日 賣出三罐
有一个阿姨 試色試一點鐘
我共你的跤 捧佇手內
腫甲 若兩粒饅頭

[Pre-Chorus]
你喝燒 我閣倒一屑仔冷水
你笑我 比你閣較驚燒

[Chorus]
來 跤囥落來 慢慢仔浸
燒水淹過 你的跤目
你的頭殼 倚佇沙發
目睭瞌咧 喙角咧笑

[Bridge]
毛巾烘燒 一跤一跤拭
跤指頭仔 紅紅軟軟
明仔載 閣愛徛十二點鐘

[Chorus]
來 跤囥落來 慢慢仔浸
燒水冷去 我閣添
你若問我 敢袂厭
你轉來 我就有燒水

[Outro]
面桶洗清氣 明仔暗閣煮

tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜下晡 熱甲袂喘氣
阿芳對阿嬸遐 借來一台剉冰機
鐵仔做的 愛用手搖
冰角囥入去 硞硞叫

[Pre-Chorus]
搖三輾 就卡牢咧
三个人 頭殼相倚咧看

[Chorus]
剉冰 剉冰 閣搖一下
冰角 冰角 莫閣卡
樣仔切甲 一塊一塊
煉奶 淋甲 溢出來

[Verse]
阿美搖甲 手骨痠
換我搖 冰角煞噴規廳
貓仔 走去眠床跤覕
阿芳 舐桌頂的煉奶

[Pre-Chorus]
冰閣卡牢 我大力一下
規台機器 倒落塗跤

[Chorus]
剉冰 剉冰 閣搖一下
冰角 冰角 滾去椅仔跤
撿起來洗洗 閣再剉
三碗冰 剉甲欲一點鐘

[Bridge]
食著第一喙 冷甲頭殼疼
阿美講 這是今年 上好食的
我講 是因為 咱家己剉的

[Chorus]
剉冰 剉冰 閣搖一下
冰角 冰角 莫閣卡
借的機器 明仔載愛還
阿嬸若問 就講 真好用

[Outro]
三支湯匙 一碗空空

Wide warm production, strings and accordion forward, light hall reverb on the voice. A mature male baritone with controlled kobushi-style turns and vibrato at the ends of lines, never shouting. 76 BPM, A minor. Weathered, steady and quietly proud. No synth-pop beat, no autotune, no rock guitar solo, no rap, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
透早五點 日頭猶未懸
我穿雨鞋 行入鹽埕
海水曝甲 一層白白
柴耙推過去 沙沙咧響

[Pre-Chorus]
三十个熱天 佇遮度過
做伙的人 一个一个無來矣

[Chorus]
曝鹽 曝鹽
日頭若火 鹽若霜
一耙一耙 推做堆
汗流落去 嘛是鹹的

[Verse]
九點遊覽車 停佇路邊
少年人攑手機 來共我翕
有一个囡仔 問阿伯
這鹽 敢會使食

[Pre-Chorus]
我共柴耙 交予伊
教伊 腰愛向 跤愛在

[Chorus]
曝鹽 曝鹽
日頭若火 鹽若霜
囡仔推甲 規身軀白
笑甲 比我較大聲

[Bridge]
鹽山堆甲 比人較懸
風對海口 吹過來
我閣推 一耙

[Chorus]
曝鹽 曝鹽
日頭若火 鹽若霜
明年熱天 猶原佇遮
等恁閣來 推一耙

[Outro]
雨鞋脫落來 鹽埕猶原白白

tracks.title: 拔索 Pue̍h-soh
tracks.subject: a tug-of-war at the neighbourhood sports day between the top and bottom ends of one lane, grandpas in front, aunties screaming orders and the rope snapping in the final
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien ska in the fast two-tone style. Off-beat clean electric guitar skank on every upbeat; a trumpet and trombone section playing unison riffs and stabs; a walking bass line with a woody upright-style tone; organ bubble on the off-beats; tight fast drums with snare fills into each chorus. Live-room sound, horns bright and up front, bass punchy, a short horn break in the bridge. A gravelly male lead, half-sung and grinning, with a rowdy banquet crowd shouting the hook back. 168 BPM, Bb major. Rowdy, bouncing and laughing. No reggaeton beat, no autotune, no trap drums, no EDM drop, no slow ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
里民運動會 拔索比賽
巷頭對巷尾 二十年的冤家
阿伯徛頭前 褲帶縛予絚
阿姆佇後壁 喝甲喉嚨破

[Pre-Chorus]
裁判的笛仔 嗶一聲
規條索仔 繃甲直直

[Chorus]
拔啊 拔啊 用力拔
巷頭的 毋通輸
跤踏予在 腰向落去
一 二 拔 一 二 拔

[Verse]
第一場 阮巷頭贏
第二場 巷尾的贏轉去
賣肉圓的 手骨上粗
王老師 手套穿兩雙

[Pre-Chorus]
決賽開始 厝邊頭尾
攏徛佇邊仔 咧喝

[Chorus]
拔啊 拔啊 用力拔
巷尾的 嘛毋通輸
阿伯的假喙齒 險險落落來
一 二 拔 一 二 拔

[Bridge]
索仔 煞斷去
兩爿的人 攏坐落塗跤
規場 笑甲徛袂起來

[Chorus]
拔啊 拔啊 莫閣拔
今年算 平手就好
索仔斷去 冤家嘛斷去
做伙去食 肉圓

[Outro]
明年閣拔 索仔愛買較粗的

tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky and out of breath
tracks.subject: a neighbour's rooster escaping at half past six on a Sunday and leading an old man in his vest, a shop clerk and the narrator through a convenience store
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien rockabilly in the 1950s Sun Records style. Slapped upright bass clicking on every beat; a twangy hollow-body electric guitar with slapback echo playing double-stop riffs and a short Travis-picked solo; brushed snare in a fast shuffle; boogie-woogie piano fills under the chorus. Vintage, close-to-mono sound, slapback echo on voice and guitar, dry drums. An energetic male tenor with hiccup accents on line ends and shouted call-outs. 176 BPM, E major. Frantic, cheeky and out of breath. No modern pop drums, no autotune, no trap, no heavy distortion, no synth.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜透早 六點半
隔壁阿伯的雞公 跳出竹籬笆
伊行入巷仔口 彼間超商
自動門 叮咚 歡迎光臨

[Pre-Chorus]
阿伯穿內衫 跤踏淺拖
喝我 少年仔 緊來鬥相共

[Chorus]
雞公走去矣 走去矣
飯丸架仔 跳過冰箱頂
店員攑掃帚 我攑菜籃仔
規間超商 雞毛規四界

[Verse]
伊飛過 關東煮的鍋
一跤踢倒 一排報紙
客人徛佇門口 攏咧錄影
阿伯喝甲 聲攏破去

[Pre-Chorus]
我撲落去 掠著一支尾溜毛
伊閣走 走出後門

[Chorus]
雞公走去矣 走去矣
巷仔頭 一直走到巷仔尾
三个人 綴佇伊後壁
規條街 笑甲腹肚疼

[Bridge]
上尾伊家己 行轉去籬笆內
跳起去 鐵枝頂徛好勢
喔喔喔 啼甲足大聲

[Chorus]
雞公轉來矣 轉來矣
阿伯喘甲 坐佇塗跤
店員講 挵歹的免賠
雞毛 留咧做紀念

[Outro]
下禮拜伊閣來 叮咚 歡迎光臨

tracks.title: มุ้งหลังแรก
tracks.subject: a young couple hanging a mosquito net in their first rented room, arguing over which corner goes where, then lying under it listening to the rain
tracks.caption: Thai soft pop-rock band ballad in the 2020s GMM band style. Clean electric guitar playing chorus-tinged arpeggios, a fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar under the verses, a crunchy overdriven rhythm guitar entering on each chorus, a warm electric bass with long notes, a live drum kit with brushed-feel verses and full snare backbeat on choruses. Warm band-in-a-room mix, guitars spread wide, lead vocal forward, short plate reverb. Male tenor, soft and close in the verses, opening into a full-voice belt on the chorus. 74 BPM, D major. Patient, tender and quietly amused. No synth pads, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean electric guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
ห้องเช่าห้องแรก สี่เหลี่ยมเล็กเล็ก
มีพัดลมตัวเดียว กับฟูกหนึ่งผืน
เธอซื้อมุ้งมาจากตลาดนัด
สีฟ้าซีดซีด ราคาร้อยห้าสิบ

[Pre-Chorus]
เชือกมุมนี้ผูกกับหน้าต่าง
มุมนั้นผูกกับตะปูที่ผนัง

[Chorus]
มุ้งหลังแรก ของเราสองคน
เบี้ยวไปข้างหนึ่ง ก็ไม่เป็นไร
ขอแค่ยุงไม่เข้า กับเธออยู่ข้างใน
ห้องเล็กแค่ไหน ก็พอแล้ว

[Verse 2]
เราเถียงกันว่า มุมไหนสูงกว่า
เธอยืนบนเก้าอี้ ฉันคอยจับไว้
ฝนเริ่มตกตอนที่ผูกเสร็จพอดี
เสียงหลังคาสังกะสี ดังทั้งคืน

[Chorus]
มุ้งหลังแรก ของเราสองคน
นอนฟังหลังคา ที่ฝนกำลังตี
เธอหลับไปก่อน มือยังกุมมือฉันไว้
ห้องเล็กแค่ไหน ก็พอแล้ว

[Outro - acoustic guitar alone]
พรุ่งนี้ค่อยผูก มุมนั้นใหม่

tracks.subject: two strangers selling T-shirts at neighbouring stalls at Chatuchak weekend market who undercut each other by ten baht all Saturday, then split one plate of pad thai at closing
tracks.caption: Thai funk-pop duo in the mid-2020s Bangkok band style. A popping slap electric bass, a scratchy sixteenth-note funk rhythm guitar, bright trumpet-and-sax brass stabs on the off-beats, a clavinet comping short chords, tight live drums with open hi-hat barks. Dry, punchy mix, bass and guitar up front, brass bright, little reverb. Two male voices trading lines: a light tenor lead and a talk-sung second voice, both in unison on the hook. 112 BPM, E minor. Cheeky, lovesick and self-mocking. No trap beat, no autotune, no EDM synth drop, no ballad tempo, no rap verse.

tracks.title: แหล่ปลดหนี้กระบะ
tracks.subject: a pickup driver paying the last of seventy-two monthly instalments and announcing it to the whole village in a lae
tracks.caption: Phleng lae luk thung, Central Thai lae recitation inside an old-school luk thung band. A breathy khlui bamboo flute opening in free time, a ranat ek xylophone answering the vocal, ching and chap cymbals keeping the beat, a walking electric bass, a luk thung drum kit with a bouncy kick-snare, a brass section with trumpet and alto sax playing unison riffs between lines. Bright old-school luk thung stage mix, brass and khlui forward, vocal dry and centred. Male luk thung baritone, opening with free-time recited lae on long ornamented vowels, then singing in strict time. 96 BPM, A minor. Proud, teasing and relieved. No modern pop production, no trap or EDM beat, no autotune, no electric guitar solo, no mor lam khaen.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - khlui flute in free time, ching]

[Verse 1 - recited lae, free time]
โอ้ละหนอ ฟังทางนี้ พี่น้องร่วมหมู่บ้าน
เจ็ดสิบสองเดือนที่ผ่านมา ข้าผ่อนกระบะไม่ขาดสักงวด
ขนมะม่วงขนปุ๋ย ขนคนเมาจากงานบวช
วันนี้เอาสลิปมาอวด งวดสุดท้ายจ่ายแล้วจ้า

[Pre-Chorus]
ไฟแนนซ์โทรมาไม่ได้แล้ว
เบอร์แปลกไม่ต้องหลบอีกต่อไป

[Chorus]
กระบะคันนี้ของข้าแล้ว
เล่มทะเบียนอยู่ในมือ
ใครจะยืมไปขนหมู ต้องมาขอกันดีๆ
เพราะมันไม่ใช่ของธนาคารอีกแล้ว

[Verse 2]
เมียข้ายิ้มเป็นครั้งแรก ตั้งแต่ปีที่ยางราคาตก
ลูกสาวเอาพวงมาลัย มาแขวนที่กระจกหน้า
ผู้ใหญ่บ้านเดินผ่านมา ถามว่าจะเลี้ยงอะไร
ข้าบอกว่าไม่เลี้ยงหรอก เงินหมดตั้งแต่งวดที่แล้ว

[Chorus]
กระบะคันนี้ของข้าแล้ว
เล่มทะเบียนอยู่ในมือ
ใครอยากนั่งกระบะหลัง ขึ้นมาเลยไม่คิดตังค์
คืนนี้วนรอบหมู่บ้านอีกสักสามรอบ

[Outro - brass riff and ching]
โอ้ละหนอ งวดสุดท้าย
ปีหน้าจะไปดาวน์รถไถต่อ

tracks.subject: a city street sweeper in an orange vest on her four a.m. shift on Sukhumvit, sweeping past clubbers spilling out and moving to the bass that leaks from the doors
tracks.caption: Thai house in the 2025 Bangkok Pissawong Records style. A steady four-on-the-floor kick with a deep rolling sub bass, a looped ranat thum wooden xylophone riff, long bowed saw u fiddle phrases with wide reverb, a ching cymbal on the off-beat, crisp open hi-hats and a soft clap on two and four. Deep club mix, warm sub, wide reverb on the fiddle, dry up-front vocal. Female alto, low and conversational, half-speaking the verses and singing the hook. 122 BPM, F minor. Hypnotic, warm and wry. No big-room EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop chorus build, no dubstep bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kick, sub bass and ranat thum loop]

[Verse 1]
ตีสี่ที่สุขุมวิท เสื้อกั๊กส้มกับไม้กวาดทางมะพร้าว
แก้วพลาสติก รองเท้าส้นสูงหนึ่งข้าง ใครทิ้งไว้
ประตูร้านเปิดทีไร เบสก็ไหลออกมาถึงฟุตบาท
ฉันกวาดไปตามจังหวะ ไม่มีใครเก็บค่าเข้า

[Chorus]
กวาด ซ้าย ขวา ตามกลองตีสี่
คนเต้นข้างใน ฉันเต้นตรงนี้
ไฟถนนเป็นไฟเวที
ไม้กวาดตีสี่ ไม่ต้องจองโต๊ะ

[Verse 2]
หนุ่มฝรั่งเมาเดินมาขอถ่ายรูปคู่ไม้กวาด
สาวชุดดำนั่งร้องไห้ ฉันยื่นทิชชูให้หนึ่งห่อ
ร้านปิดไฟตอนตีห้า เพลงหยุดกลางท่อนพอดี
แต่ฉันยังได้ยินมันอยู่ ในหัวจนถึงเช้า

[Chorus]
กวาด ซ้าย ขวา ตามกลองตีห้า
คนกลับบ้านหมด ฉันยังกวาดต่อ
แสงแรกเป็นไฟเวที
ไม้กวาดตีห้า ยังเต้นคนเดียว

[Outro - saw u fiddle over the loop]
รถขยะมาแล้ว
เพลงสุดท้ายของคืนนี้

tracks.title: ลุงจูนเสา
tracks.subject: an uncle on the soi who climbs every neighbour's roof to fix their TV antenna and shouts down asking whether the picture is back
tracks.caption: Neo Thai funk in the 2025 FORD TRIO style. An electric phin lute playing tight funk sixteenth-note riffs on molam scales, a wah electric guitar answering it, a soft Rhodes electric piano holding minor ninth chords, a syncopated electric bass, live drums with ghost-note snare and a conga loop. Warm analogue groove, phin and bass up front, Rhodes soft and wide, light tape saturation. Male tenor with smooth neo-soul phrasing and a playful falsetto ad-lib on the hook. 104 BPM, G minor. Playful, sunny and neighbourly. No trap beat, no autotune, no EDM drop, no khaen drone, no luk thung brass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - phin funk riff and conga]

[Verse 1]
บ่ายสามลุงแบกบันไดไม้ เดินผ่านหน้าบ้านทุกหลัง
ใครภาพทีวีเป็นเม็ดซ่า ลุงรู้ก่อนเราอีก
ปีนขึ้นหลังคาสังกะสี หมุนเสาก้างปลาไปทีละนิด
แล้วตะโกนลงมาถามว่า ชัดหรือยังหลาน

[Pre-Chorus]
ยังไม่ชัดลุง ซ้ายอีกนิด
เออ ตรงนั้นแหละ อย่าขยับ

[Chorus]
ลุงจูนเสา ลุงจูนเสา
ละครหลังข่าวกลับมาเพราะลุงเรา
ไม่รับเงินสักบาท ขอแค่น้ำแข็งหนึ่งแก้ว
ลุงจูนเสา หลังคาไหนก็ไปแล้ว

[Verse 2]
ตอนนี้ใครๆ ก็ดูในมือถือ ไม่มีใครเรียกลุงแล้ว
ลุงยังแบกบันไดผ่านมา มองหลังคาทุกบ้าน
วันนี้เน็ตล่มทั้งซอย ตั้งแต่หัวค่ำ
ยายบ้านท้ายซอยตะโกน ลุงมาดูเสาหน่อย

[Chorus]
ลุงจูนเสา ลุงจูนเสา
ทั้งซอยนั่งดูทีวีจอเดียวกับเรา
ลูกหลานวางมือถือ มานั่งหน้าบ้านลุง
ลุงจูนเสา คืนนี้ไม่มีใครเหงา

[Outro - phin and Rhodes, fade]
ชัดหรือยังหลาน
ชัดแล้วลุง ลงมากินข้าว

tracks.subject: five students in one shared document at three in the morning finishing a group report due at eight, and one of them typing into the wrong section the whole night
tracks.caption: Pop-punk, early-2000s skate-punk style with a Saigon garage-band feel. Two palm-muted distorted guitars trading power chords, a pick-played bass running eighth notes, fast snare-driven punk drums with crash-heavy choruses, a short single-note guitar lead in the intro. Tight, dry, bright band mix recorded live-off-the-floor. Young male lead vocal, mid register, slightly nasal pop-punk delivery, unison gang shouts on the chorus. 172 BPM, D major. Breathless, comic, self-mocking energy. No synths, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no ballad slowdown.

tracks.subject: a diss track aimed at the bánh mì cart lady on the corner who spreads him half the pâté she gives the guy in front of him every single morning
tracks.caption: Vietnamese battle-rap diss track, head-nodding hard boom-bap pocket. A heavy dry kick and cracking snare, a dark three-note piano stab repeating every bar, deep sub bass, a short dan tranh glissando between sections as a mock-heroic flourish. Punchy, upfront, dry mix with the voice loud and centred. Male rapper, mid register, sharp, enunciated battle cadence with sarcastic pauses and punchline emphasis. 92 BPM, E minor. Cocky, petty, comic. No sung pop hook, no autotune, no melodic trap flow, no EDM build, no rock guitars.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano stab, dan tranh glissando]

[Verse 1]
Sáng nào cũng vậy, sáu giờ mười lăm
Xe bánh mì đầu hẻm, cô Năm đứng sẵn
Thằng phía trước tôi, pa-tê dày một đốt
Tới lượt tôi, cô quẹt như sơn móng
Hai chục nghìn y nhau, mà ổ tôi lép xẹp
Dưa leo một lát, chả lụa mỏng như tờ lịch
Tôi hỏi cô ơi, sao con ít vậy
Cô nói tại con, sáng nào cũng nhăn mặt

[Chorus]
Thiếu pa-tê, thiếu pa-tê
Cô Năm ơi cô xử ép con hoài
Thiếu pa-tê, thiếu pa-tê
Bài này con viết, cô nghe cho đã tai

[Verse 2]
Tôi thử đi sớm, năm giờ năm lăm
Cô chưa mở xe, ngồi đó nhặt rau
Tôi thử cười tươi, khen cô hôm nay trẻ
Cô quẹt thêm chút, rồi lấy lại một nửa
Thằng phía trước tôi, hóa ra là con rể
Bảo sao pa-tê, dày như cái nệm
Thôi được rồi cô, con xin chịu thua
Cô còn con gái không, con xin làm rể luôn

[Chorus]
Thiếu pa-tê, thiếu pa-tê
Cô Năm cười, quẹt thêm một vá
Thiếu pa-tê, giờ hết thiếu rồi
Ổ hôm nay dày, con ăn không hết

[Outro - piano stab stops, dan tranh glissando]
Mai con lại tới, cô nhớ phần con

tracks.title: Tết Tóc Cho Em
tracks.subject: a husband learning to braid his wife's hair while her arm is in a cast
tracks.caption: Intimate Vietnamese piano ballad, singer-songwriter style. Felted upright piano with gentle broken chords and audible pedal, a soft legato cello entering in the second verse, light brushed snare only in the last chorus. Close, warm small-room recording, wooden and unpolished. Male tenor vocal, close-mic, soft, conversational and unforced, gentle falsetto on one high note. 72 BPM, A-flat major. Tender, shy, quietly funny love song. No strings swell, no big drum fill, no key change, no autotune, no arena ballad build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano, pedal noise]

[Verse 1]
Tay em bó bột trắng, ngồi trước gương thở dài
Tóc rối sau lưng, em bảo anh thử coi
Anh xem clip ba lần, mười ngón tay lóng ngóng
Chia làm ba phần mà phần nào cũng lệch

[Chorus]
Ngồi yên nha em, để anh tết tóc cho em
Bên trái đè giữa, bên phải đè lên
Nếu nó xấu hơn hôm qua
Em cứ cười, anh sẽ làm lại từ đầu

[Verse 2]
Sáng thứ hai anh trễ làm mười lăm phút
Đồng nghiệp hỏi sao, anh chỉ cười trừ
Đến tuần thứ ba bím tóc đã thẳng hàng
Em nói tháo bột rồi, anh vẫn muốn làm

[Chorus]
Ngồi yên nha em, để anh tết tóc cho em
Bên trái đè giữa, bên phải đè lên
Cái dây thun màu vàng em thích
Anh để trong túi áo, mỗi sáng mang theo

[Outro - piano alone]
Tay em lành rồi
Mà anh chưa muốn dừng

tracks.title: Cúp Điện Trên Sân Thượng
tracks.subject: neighbours dancing on an apartment rooftop during a summer power cut
tracks.caption: Amapiano-influenced V-pop, private-school amapiano groove with pop structure. Gliding log-drum bass notes, busy shakers and open hi-hats, mellow Rhodes chords with jazzy extensions, a soft whistled synth-flute line in the intro. Warm, spacious mix with heavy round low end and gentle reverb. Female lead vocal, airy mid register, relaxed behind-the-beat phrasing, light harmony on the chorus. 113 BPM, F minor. Playful, loose, flirty summer-night mood. No sampled voices, no trap hi-hat rolls, no EDM drop, no autotune, no four-on-the-floor house kick.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - log drum, shakers, Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
Tám giờ tối cả khu chung cư tối om
Thang máy đứng im, quạt trần cũng thôi quay
Cả tầng mười hai rủ nhau leo cầu thang bộ
Lên sân thượng hóng gió, ai cũng cầm theo đèn pin

[Pre-Chorus]
Có anh phòng tám cầm cái loa nhỏ xíu
Bật một bài lạ mà ai cũng lắc vai

[Chorus]
Cúp điện thì mình nhảy
Đèn pin chiếu dưới chân
Anh ơi đừng nhìn em vậy
Nóng lắm, đứng xa một chút thôi

[Verse 2]
Cô bán xôi dạy cả xóm bước qua bước lại
Thằng bé tầng dưới nhảy như con tôm
Anh đưa em chai nước đá còn lạnh
Nói khi nào có điện, đi ăn chè không

[Pre-Chorus]
Loa nhỏ hết pin, cả đám tự hát
Vỗ tay làm nhịp, chân vẫn không ngừng

[Chorus]
Cúp điện thì mình nhảy
Đèn pin chiếu dưới chân
Anh ơi cứ nhìn em vậy
Đứng gần thêm một chút cũng được

[Outro - log drum fades, crowd hums]
Đèn sáng lại rồi
Mình nhảy thêm bài nữa

tracks.title: Bố Chạy Theo Sau
tracks.subject: a father running behind his daughter's first motorbike ride in the alley
tracks.caption: Saigon ska orchestra pop in the big expat-and-local ska band style of Ho Chi Minh City's bar scene. Off-beat clean electric guitar skank on every upbeat; a trumpet, trombone and tenor sax section playing warm unison melodies and short stabs; a walking bass; a bright organ bubbling on the off-beats; brisk live drums with snare fills into each chorus. Live big-band room sound, horns up front, bass punchy. Female lead vocal, clear mid register, earnest and plain, no runs. 132 BPM, G major. Warm, nostalgic, gently funny. No punk power chords, no trap beat, no autotune, no EDM drop, no reggae slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - horn section melody, off-beat guitar skank]

[Verse 1]
Hẻm nhà mình dài đúng một trăm mét
Chiếc Cub cũ màu xanh, gương chiếu hậu lệch
Bố nói ga nhẹ thôi, tay phải đừng run
Con chạy được ba mét, bố hô đứng lại

[Pre-Chorus]
Bố mang dép tổ ong chạy bên hông xe
Tay vẫn giữ yên sau mà con không hay

[Chorus]
Bố chạy theo sau, thở không ra hơi
Cả hẻm đứng xem, bà bán nước cười
Con quay lại hỏi, bố buông tay chưa
Bố nói buông rồi, mà tay vẫn chưa

[Verse 2]
Giờ con đi làm qua cầu Sài Gòn
Kẹt xe giờ tan, mưa ướt cả lưng
Đèn đỏ đứng chờ, con nhìn vào gương
Tưởng như dép tổ ong còn chạy phía sau

[Chorus]
Bố chạy theo sau, giờ bố đi chậm hơn
Con chở bố đi tái khám mỗi tháng
Bố ngồi yên sau, tay vịn eo con
Nói ga nhẹ thôi, như ngày xưa

[Outro - horns ring out]
Một trăm mét hẻm nhà
Con vẫn chạy chậm

tracks.title: 幫你影多張
tracks.mood: cocky, put-upon and grinning, a boyfriend playing the martyr for laughs
tracks.subject: a boyfriend stuck shooting two hundred photos of his girlfriend in front of a Sheung Wan mural, crouching, climbing a bollard, blocking tourists, until she picks the very first one
tracks.caption: Cantonese male-idol dance-pop in the 2025 Hong Kong boy-group choreography style. A punchy four-on-the-floor kick with a layered clap on two and four; sidechained supersaw stabs on the off-beat; a slap-style synth bass bouncing in octaves; a muted funk electric guitar chopping sixteenths; brass-synth hits marking every section change. Tight and loud mix, wide synths, dry upfront lead vocal, short plate reverb on the chorus. Male tenor, bright and clipped, half-rapping the verses with a cheeky swagger, belting the chorus, a group of male voices shouting the hook. 122 BPM, A minor. Cocky, put-upon and grinning. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no slow ballad breakdown, no EDM festival drop, no female lead.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
上環嗰幅牆 你話光線啱啱好
我跪喺地下 膝頭哥貼住條渠
你話腳要長啲 要我再蹲低啲
旅行團行過 我仲要閃埋一邊

[Pre-Chorus]
你撥吓頭髮 又話唔夠自然
我講三二一 你又眨咗眼

[Chorus]
幫你影多張 再影多張
左邊少少 右邊又唔得
幫你影多張 再影多張
我部電話熱到 好似煲緊湯

[Verse]
第八十張 我爬上咗個石墩
保安望住我 我笑笑扮遊客
你話背景有個阿伯 行咗過去先
阿伯企定定 原來佢都喺度影相

[Pre-Chorus]
你話望住我 唔好望住鏡頭
我話望住你 我點對焦

[Chorus]
幫你影多張 再影多張
企高少少 跪低又唔得
幫你影多張 再影多張
二百張相 我對腳已經冇晒知覺

[Bridge]
你碌返上去 碌到最頂
你話第一張 第一張最靚

[Chorus]
幫你影多張 唔使影多張
第一張就得 早講就得
下個禮拜 又去邊度影
我帶定護膝 你記住唔好眨眼

[Outro]
三二一 喂 唔好眨眼

tracks.title: 得返三蚊
tracks.mood: tipsy, giddy and broke, laughing at a two a.m. problem
tracks.subject: leaving a Lan Kwai Fong club at 1:40 a.m. with three dollars left on her Octopus card, missing the last train by a minute and walking to the Central minibus stand with friends
tracks.caption: Cantonese piano-house built for a Hong Kong club night where the crowd sings along in Cantonese. Classic early-90s house piano stabs in bright minor-seventh chords; a four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats on the off-beats; a rolling sub-octave house bassline; tambourine sixteenths; short string-pad swells into each chorus. Club-wide and bright, the piano forward, kick and bass locked tight, light hall reverb on the voice. Female mezzo, warm and loose, diva-house phrasing held straight without melisma, answered by a male backing voice. 124 BPM, F minor. Tipsy, giddy and broke, laughing at a two a.m. problem. No trap drums, no autotune, no dubstep or big-room drop, no disco string orchestra, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
一點四十 落到蘭桂坊條斜
高踭鞋拎喺手 對腳仲識跳
阿敏話尾班車 仲有一分鐘
我哋跑到中環站 閘已經落咗

[Pre-Chorus]
我拍一拍八達通
部機話我 得返三蚊

[Chorus]
得返三蚊 得返三蚊
今晚跳到 銀包都跳埋
得返三蚊 唔夠搭的士
不如行過去 等綠van

[Verse]
皇后大道 冇車冇人
我哋三個 喺斑馬線跳舞
便利店入面 拍卡買咗支水
一支水 三個人輪住飲

[Pre-Chorus]
部機嘟一聲 我望一望
個數話我 得返零蚊

[Chorus]
得返零蚊 得返零蚊
阿敏話佢 有十蚊銀
得返零蚊 都唔緊要
綠van司機 收我哋硬幣

[Bridge]
坐喺最尾 窗外仲係黑
阿敏瞓咗 個頭靠住我

[Chorus]
得返零蚊 得返零蚊
聽朝增值 今晚唔理
得返零蚊 首歌仲響緊
成架綠van 跟住我哋唱

[Outro]
下個禮拜 再嚟過

tracks.caption: Cantonese reggae in the roots one-drop style of the Hong Kong reggae scene. tracks.title: 又跳掣
tracks.mood: sweaty, wry and loyal, four friends laughing between flights of stairs
tracks.subject: four friends cooking hotpot in a tiny subdivided flat in Sham Shui Po in August, the breaker tripping every time the air-con and the induction cooker run together
tracks.caption: Hong Kong indie band pop in the 2025 local band wave, a four-piece playing live in one room. Two clean electric guitars, one chiming bright arpeggios high on the neck and one chopping off-beat chords; a melodic picked electric bass walking up to each chorus; live drums with a busy sixteenth hi-hat and quick snare fills; a Wurlitzer electric piano holding the chords. Live-room band sound, guitars panned left and right, bass up front, very little reverb. Male light tenor, conversational in the verses, lifting into falsetto on the chorus, the band joining as a gang vocal on the last chorus. 132 BPM, D major. Sweaty, wry and loyal. No pop-punk power chords, no stadium rock guitar solo, no synth pads, no autotune, no ballad tempo drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
八月 深水埗 劏房一百呎
四個人圍住 一個電磁爐
阿Ken帶咗肥牛 阿傑帶咗魚蛋
我開冷氣 個湯啱啱滾

[Pre-Chorus]
啪 一聲 成間屋黑晒
大家喺度 摸住條筷子

[Chorus]
又跳掣 又跳掣
冷氣同火鍋 只可以揀一樣
又跳掣 又跳掣
四個人摸黑 笑到肚痛

[Verse]
熄冷氣 先開爐
汗流到落埋 個湯度
阿傑除咗衫 阿Ken撥住扇
魚蛋浮起 我哋搶到打交

[Pre-Chorus]
熄爐 開返冷氣
啪 又一聲 唔知邊個撳錯

[Chorus]
又跳掣 又跳掣
電錶箱喺門口 我行咗十轉
又跳掣 又跳掣
樓上阿伯 敲門問我哋搞乜

[Bridge]
最後拎個爐 出去後樓梯
四個人坐喺石級 夜風都係熱嘅

[Chorus]
又跳掣 又跳掣
後樓梯嘅火鍋 原來最好食
又跳掣 下個月再嚟
記住帶多 一把扇

[Outro]
啪 一聲 再嚟過

tracks.mood: tender, unhurried and quietly amused, a Sunday at home
tracks.subject: teaching her boyfriend to fold wontons at the folding table of their small flat on a Sunday afternoon, every one of his falling apart in the pot
tracks.caption: Cantonese bossa nova sung over a classic Brazilian groove. tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜日 下晝 摺枱打開
一碗肉碎 一疊雲吞皮
你話你識 你阿媽教過
點知第一隻 肉都爆晒出嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
手指點啲水 邊邊黐埋
我捉住你隻手 一下一下摺

[Chorus]
包雲吞 一隻一隻
你包到似信封 我包到似金魚
包雲吞 唔使咁急
我哋有成個下晝 慢慢包

[Verse]
你話蝦要擺 啱啱中間
肉唔好放咁多 咁貪心
你包嗰隻 大過我隻手
你仲話佢 最有誠意

[Pre-Chorus]
水滾咗 一隻隻放落去
你嗰幾隻 即刻散晒

[Chorus]
包雲吞 一隻一隻
你嗰啲變咗 肉碎湯
包雲吞 你唔好嬲
我食晒你嗰碗 一滴都唔剩

[Bridge]
枱面一層麵粉 你塊面又有
我幫你抹 你又抹返落我度

[Chorus]
包雲吞 下個禮拜再嚟
你話今次 一定包得靚
包雲吞 唔靚都冇所謂
你包幾多 我都食幾多

[Outro]
最後一隻 我哋一齊包

tracks.title: 師傅這首是DJ版
tracks.mood: sleepy turning giddy, laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a ride-hailing passenger in a suit at 2 a.m. whose driver only plays DJ remixes of old love songs, and who ends up asking to go around the block again
tracks.caption: Douyin car-DJ remix pop in the Chinese 車載DJ / 慢搖 style, an old Mandopop love-song melody rebuilt for a club. A hard four-on-the-floor kick with an offbeat open hi-hat; a plucked supersaw synth lead doubling the vocal melody between lines; a sidechained pumping synth bass; snare-roll risers into each chorus. Loud, compressed and bright with a heavy sub low end, mixed like a car stereo turned all the way up. Male tenor, casual and conversational in the verses, belting the chorus like a KTV regular. 128 BPM, A minor. Sleepy turning giddy, laughing at himself. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dubstep wobble drop, no rap verse, no acoustic ballad intro.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - four-on-the-floor kick and plucked synth lead]

[Verse 1]
凌晨兩點我叫了一台車
師傅的音響開得像夜店
西裝領帶我只想睡一下
他說老闆你聽這首經典

[Pre-Chorus]
明明是愛如潮水的旋律
怎麼底下多了動次動次

[Chorus]
師傅 這首是DJ版
後座的窗戶都在震
我說關小聲一點點
他說好 然後再加三格

[Verse 2]
過了三個紅燈我開始點頭
領帶早就塞進公事包
第五首副歌我先唱出口
師傅從後照鏡對我笑

[Pre-Chorus]
導航說還有十二分鐘
我說要不要繞一下路

[Chorus - snare roll, full drop]
師傅 這首是DJ版
整條高架都在晃
我說再大聲一點點
他說好 我們再繞一圈

[Outro - synth lead and kick fade]
到了樓下我還不想下車
五顆星 備註下次還放這首

tracks.title: 星期六的熱乾麵
tracks.mood: warm, a little nervous, quietly proud
tracks.subject: learning to make his girlfriend's Wuhan hometown breakfast, hot dry noodles, every Saturday and never quite getting it right
tracks.caption: Mandarin Britpop with mid-90s British guitar-band swagger. A jangly twelve-string electric guitar ringing open chords; a crunchy rhythm guitar on the backbeat; a melodic bass walking under the changes; tambourine and straight rock drums; a Hammond organ pad entering on the last chorus. Warm and roomy, guitars wide, the voice centred and dry. Male baritone-tenor, plain and sincere with a slightly nasal tone, an easy singalong chorus. 112 BPM, D major. Warm, a little nervous, quietly proud. No synth pads, no R&B runs, no autotune, no trap drums, no power-ballad key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - jangly twelve-string guitar and tambourine]

[Verse 1]
妳說武漢的早上是芝麻醬的味道
我買了鹼水麵 照著影片一步步做
第一碗太乾 第二碗太鹹
妳還是吃完 說下禮拜再來

[Pre-Chorus]
週六八點 鍋子比妳先醒
妳在被子裡數我又失敗幾次

[Chorus]
就算我一輩子拌不出妳家巷口那一碗
我還是每個星期六 把芝麻醬調開
妳說差一點 我說那就下次
差一點 剛好留給我們慢慢來

[Verse 2]
第十個星期六 我加了蘿蔔丁
妳站在廚房門口 一句話也不說
吃到一半 妳打給妳媽
說有個人 麵煮得還可以

[Pre-Chorus]
電話那頭笑得好大聲
我假裝洗碗 把水開到最大

[Chorus - organ enters]
就算我一輩子拌不出妳家巷口那一碗
我還是每個星期六 把芝麻醬調開
妳說今天這碗 差不多了
差不多 就夠我再煮好幾十年

[Outro - guitars ring out]
下個週六 妳說換妳來煮
我坐在旁邊 負責說差一點

tracks.title: 第四輪
tracks.subject: the fourth round of interviews for the same job, in a cousin's borrowed suit
tracks.caption: Mandarin grunge in the early-90s Seattle loud-quiet-loud mould. A detuned overdriven guitar through a fuzz pedal, clean and wobbly in the verses and slamming into a sludgy wall in the chorus; a distorted bass doubling the riff; loose, heavy drums with crashing cymbals; guitar feedback between sections. Thick and murky, garage-room drums, little polish. Male baritone, flat and mumbled in the verses, raw and shouted in the chorus. 92 BPM, E minor. Numb, sardonic, slowly boiling over. No pop-punk bounce, no metalcore breakdown, no screamed growls, no synths, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - detuned guitar riff and loose drums]

[Verse 1]
同一間會議室 同一杯溫水
西裝是表哥的 袖子長了一截
他們問我五年後在哪裡
我說應該還在這張椅子上

[Pre-Chorus]
冷氣開那麼強
我的手心還是濕的

[Chorus]
第四輪 第四輪
他們說只是聊一聊
我把笑容折好放在桌上
等他們說 回去等通知

[Verse 2]
電梯裡碰到上一輪的那個人
他也穿著不合身的外套
我們都沒說話 只是點頭
十七樓到一樓 怎麼那麼久

[Bridge - bass and feedback only]
如果還有第五輪
我想穿自己的衣服來

[Chorus - shouted, full fuzz wall]
第四輪 第四輪
他們說只是聊一聊
我把領帶扯下來塞進口袋
走出大門 才發現外面在下雨

[Outro - guitar feedback]
表哥打電話來問
西裝什麼時候還

tracks.title: 閉館前十分鐘
tracks.subject: swimming the last laps at a public pool ten minutes before closing on the last day of summer holidays
tracks.caption: Mandarin slacker indie rock in the Taipei bedroom-band style, loose and unhurried. Two clean electric guitars strummed lazily and a little behind the beat; a warbling lead guitar with tape flutter playing short melodies between lines; loose live drums with brushes and a dry snare; a melodic fingered bass; an alto saxophone answering the chorus. Loose, sun-bleached, dry live-room sound with a slight tape wobble. Female soprano, breathy and close, half-whispered, unbothered. 84 BPM, F major. Drowsy, weightless, quietly reluctant. No shoegaze distortion wall, no long reverb wash, no EDM drop, no R&B runs, no trap hi-hats, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - lazy strummed guitars and brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
八月最後一天 游泳池快關了
救生員坐在高椅上 打了一個哈欠
燈一盞一盞暗下來
我還想再來回 一趟就好

[Pre-Chorus]
哨子還沒響
我把耳朵沉進水裡

[Chorus]
閉館前十分鐘
整座城市都浮在水面上
我在底下 數自己的呼吸
慢慢的 誰也找不到我

[Verse 2]
置物櫃的鑰匙 繞在手腕上
氯的味道 留在頭髮裡一整晚
明天開學 公車要早一站下
今天我還可以 浮著不動

[Pre-Chorus]
哨子響了
我假裝沒有聽見

[Chorus - saxophone joins]
閉館前一分鐘
整個夏天都浮在水面上
我在底下 再數三下
上來的時候 燈已經關了

[Outro - warbling lead guitar and saxophone]
救生員說 明年見
我說 嗯 明年見

tracks.title: 舅舅搶麥克風
tracks.subject: a ska band hired for a wedding banquet when the groom's uncle grabs the microphone during the toast round
tracks.caption: Mandarin ska in the two-tone revival style of Taiwan and Hong Kong ska bands. A choppy offbeat upstroke guitar skank; a trumpet and trombone horn section punching unison riffs; a walking electric bass; fast two-tone drums with rimshots and a driving hi-hat; a bouncy organ doubling the skank. Live and punchy, horns bright and forward, a small banquet-hall room sound. Male tenor, bright and talky, with shouted gang vocals from the horn players on the chorus. 158 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, cheeky, banquet-hall chaos. No reggae one-drop slowdown, no heavy metal guitars, no EDM, no autotune, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - guitar skank and trumpet-trombone riff]

[Verse 1]
喜宴第三道菜 我們剛上台
新郎說來點歡樂的 不要太吵
小號才吹兩下 第七桌站起來
新郎的舅舅 端著紹興走過來

[Pre-Chorus]
他說借一下 一下就好
手已經握住了麥克風

[Chorus]
舅舅搶麥克風 舅舅搶麥克風
他要唱一首 二十年前的歌
我們只好跟上 他自己的調
整個宴會廳 跟著跳

[Verse 2]
他唱錯了歌詞 沒人敢說
新娘的姑姑 在台下打拍子
長號手笑到 吹不出聲
服務生端著魚 也在搖

[Pre-Chorus]
新郎看著我 搖搖頭
可是他嘴角在偷笑

[Chorus - gang vocals]
舅舅搶麥克風 舅舅不還麥克風
他又點一首 說是新娘最愛
我們只好跟上 他又升了調
整個宴會廳 跳到上甜湯

[Outro - horns and skank fade]
散場他塞給我一個紅包
說明年他兒子結婚 你們再來
